# Weblio英和辞典・和英辞典

> Comprehensive English-Japanese dictionary and learning platform with 504k words, TOEIC preparation, business email templates, and story-based vocabulary building.

Weblio's English-Japanese dictionary service provides extensive word definitions, usage examples, pronunciation guides, and supplementary learning resources for English learners of all levels. The platform integrates vocabulary reference with practical business communication tools and standardized test preparation.

## Key Topics

- English-Japanese dictionary
- TOEIC preparation
- Business English
- Email templates
- Vocabulary learning
- Word definitions
- English grammar
- Pronunciation
- Language learning
- Professional communication
- Japanese translation
- English examples
- Correspondence templates
- English coaching
- Vocabulary building

## Core Dictionary & Reference

- [Weblio英和辞典・和英辞典](https://ejje.weblio.jp): Main English-Japanese dictionary with 504k words, idioms, audio pronunciation, and comprehensive usage information.
- [have - Word Definition & Usage](https://ejje.weblio.jp/content/have): Dictionary reference for verb 'have' with conjugations, meanings, and example sentences.
- [provide - Word Definition & Usage](https://ejje.weblio.jp/content/provide): Dictionary entry for 'provide' with meanings, usage examples, and TOEIC/英検 relevance.
- [emerge - Word Definition & Usage](https://ejje.weblio.jp/content/emerge): Dictionary entry for 'emerge' with meanings, usage patterns, and TOEIC preparation notes.
- [feed - Word Definition & Usage](https://ejje.weblio.jp/content/feed): Dictionary reference for verb 'feed' with definitions and contextual example sentences.
- [slick - Word Definition & Usage](https://ejje.weblio.jp/content/slick): Dictionary entry for 'slick' with definitions, examples, and practical usage information.

## TOEIC & English Learning

- [EigoBuffet - TOEIC対策サイト](https://ejje.weblio.jp/lpage/sapiens-eigobuffet): Comprehensive TOEIC preparation platform featuring 5000+ practice questions and score improvement strategies.
- [読んで学ぶ英語](https://ejje.weblio.jp/reading/story-learning): Story-based English learning program with reading comprehension exercises and vocabulary building activities.

## Business English & Email Templates

- [英語メールテンプレート文例集](https://ejje.weblio.jp/template/OETMS): Comprehensive collection of business English email templates for professional correspondence and communication.
- [アポイントメントの申し込み](https://ejje.weblio.jp/template/OETMS/%E3%82%A2%E3%83%9D%E3%82%A4%E3%83%B3%E3%83%88/%E3%82%A2%E3%83%9D%E3%82%A4%E3%83%B3%E3%83%88%E3%83%A1%E3%83%B3%E3%83%88%E3%81%AE%E7%A2%BA%E8%AA%8D%E3%83%BB%E5%A4%89%E6%9B%B4): Email template for confirming and changing appointment meetings in English business communication.
- [アドバイスへのお礼](https://ejje.weblio.jp/template/OETMS/%E6%A5%AD%E5%8B%99%E9%80%A3%E7%B5%A1/%E3%82%A2%E3%83%89%E3%83%90%E3%82%A4%E3%82%B9%E3%81%B8%E3%81%AE%E3%81%8A%E7%A4%BC): Business email template for professionally thanking someone for advice in English.
- [仕事の依頼](https://ejje.weblio.jp/template/OETMS/%E6%A5%AD%E5%8B%99%E9%80%A3%E7%B5%A1/%E4%BB%95%E4%BA%8B%E3%81%AE%E4%BE%9D%E9%A0%BC): Business email template for requesting work assistance and task delegation in English.
- [アポイントメントの申し込み返信（面会に応じる）](https://ejje.weblio.jp/template/OETMS/%E3%82%A2%E3%83%9D%E3%82%A4%E3%83%B3%E3%83%88/%E3%82%A2%E3%83%9D%E3%82%A4%E3%83%B3%E3%83%88%E3%83%A1%E3%83%B3%E3%83%88%E3%81%AE%E7%A2%BA%E8%AA%8D%E3%83%BB%E5%A4%89%E6%9B%B4): Email template for responding positively to appointment requests for interviews in English.
- [アポイントメント日程の変更へのお礼](https://ejje.weblio.jp/template/OETMS/%E3%82%A2%E3%83%9D%E3%82%A4%E3%83%B3%E3%83%88/%E3%82%A2%E3%83%9D%E3%82%A4%E3%83%B3%E3%83%88%E6%97%A5%E7%A8%8B%E3%81%AE%E5%A4%89%E6%9B%B4%E3%81%B8%E3%81%AE%E3%81%8A%E7%A4%BC): Email template for professionally thanking someone for rescheduling an appointment in English.

## Optional

- [連絡先・メールアドレス変更のお知らせ](https://ejje.weblio.jp/template/OETMS/%E3%81%8A%E7%9F%A5%E3%82%89%E3%81%9B/%E9%80%A3%E7%B5%A1%E5%85%88%E3%83%BB%E3%83%A1%E3%83%BC%E3%83%AB%E3%82%A2%E3%83%89%E3%83%AC%E3%82%B9%E5%A4%89%E6%9B%B4%E3%81%AE%E3%81%8A%E7%9F%A5%E3%82%89%E3%81%9B): Email template for notifying contacts of address and email changes in English.
- [不採用の通知](https://ejje.weblio.jp/template/OETMS/%E6%B1%82%E4%BA%BA%E3%83%BB%E6%B1%82%E8%81%B7/%E4%B8%8D%E6%8E%A1%E7%94%A8%E3%81%AE%E9%80%9A%E7%9F%A5): HR email template for job rejection notification in English and Japanese.
